```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(targets)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
```

Including all data   

```{r}
tar_load(df)
sk_subset <- df |> 
  dplyr::select(c(ID, Tanzania, High, female, mean_cheapest_asset, CCEI_PQR, FOSD_PQR, EU_PQR))
sk_subset |> write_xlsx(here::here("tables", "sk_subset.xlsx"))
```
